path_length.definition: sum of causal state-vector step distances in the trailing geometry window

transport_efficiency_active.definition: net_displacement/path_length only when path_length exceeds the activity threshold; otherwise null

recurrence_persistence_raw.definition: trailing mean of current-state distance-weighted recurrence, retained as a diagnostic of return or regional permanence
recurrence_persistence_raw.local_scale: median positive admissible pair distance in the causal geometry window

mobile_recurrence_persistence.activity_indicator: 1 iff geometry_ready and path_length > activity threshold; otherwise 0

stagnant_fraction.definition: causal count of STAGNANT geometry-ready windows divided by elapsed geometry-ready windows

crystallized_fraction.definition: causal count of CRYSTALLIZED geometry-ready windows divided by elapsed geometry-ready windows

state_machine.VIABLE: active AND not RECURRENT AND not CRYSTALLIZING
state_machine.reset: STAGNANT, VIABLE, or RECURRENT resets crystallizing duration to zero

claim_boundary: Version 4 was specified after the minimal-structural perturbation v3 results and remains exploratory.
Static stagnation and movement-conditioned recurrence are distinct, non-ordinal degradation modes.
Raw recurrence can reflect regional permanence and cannot by itself activate recurrence or crystallization.
Transport efficiency is invalid for classification and contrasts when path length does not exceed the activity threshold.
Parameters are identical across models, tasks, arms, providers, and outcomes.
Saved numeric observations are reused; no LLM receives observer information.
